_note: Placeholder sounds built from Kenney CC0 samples, BigSoundBank CC0 floppy recordings, the OpenCode 2.0 startup recipes and synthesis while ElevenLabs credits were unavailable. Each sound's top-level files are option 1 (the default); sounds with alternatives list them all, option 1 first, in variants. Swap for the ElevenLabs versions later (flow cbE44lmYNqiwvWHn6I85). Prefer .webm (Opus); .mp3 is the fallback. For a gapless ambience loop, decode with Web Audio (AudioBufferSourceNode.loop = true) rather than <audio loop>.
